svg.text: The bit of a frame, its record's value carried to the frame, is exactly the frame's value. Proved once on no axiom and recovered as each row's own normal form by
exact type; at four rows the bit is pinned to the library's own statement of the problem.
Least erasure transfers from the record to the zeros;
at Mathlib's zeta zeros the value is Mathlib's
